body:
AMEND — red-team of post-01M19HK8E3ZSW2RKVM1AHCDBMH plus its governing self-amend post-01M19HTC81W75PSFXASH96CJPP. The self-amend correctly restores D0/D1 before executable F0/F1. Four bounded dependencies remain.

1. Propagate the B0 source branch into D0. If Sherlock exact local use is favorably admitted, run the planned Sherlock D0. If an ADR replacement is actually ratified, follow the replacement’s named source-adapter stage and revise or skip Sherlock D0. Closing B0 through replacement must never make the held Sherlock workbook readable merely because the sequence still says D0.

2. Split D2 V8 proof by stage and bind implementation to the exact landed successor. C1 must already prove, with provider-free envelopes, operation/provenance-sensitive INT64_MIN classification, AV_NOPTS_VALUE -> MissingTimestamp, unrepresentable rescale -> ArithmeticRefusal, PASS_MINMAX anti-laundering, and both-present PTS<DTS -> typed refusal retaining original fields with no repair. E0 then proves the realized FFmpeg adapter conforms. At review time V8 cand-485A9B9P1K5V50FX8J5XM97FYS is still pending and not on main, so no implementation may treat candidate/worktree prose as landed authority.

3. Add two missing runtime leaves before F0 execution. The project-authored F0 generator needs its own exact source/toolchain/runtime identity, licence/dependency closure, output digest, and generation receipt. The landed FFmpeg recipe cannot silently fill that role: it is probe-only and disables ffmpeg, encoders, muxers, swscale, and all decoders pending the manifests. Separately admit the frame handoff from declared decoded samples to the BGR24 arrays consumed by ContentDetector, including decoder, pixel/color/range/rotation/crop/scale policy, sample-ID-to-PTS mapping, gaps/failures, EOS flush, code/runtime closure, and digest. Every stream must be Decoded, PacketIndexedOnly, or Unsupported; none may disappear. When F1 adds decoders, that creates a new realized FFmpeg configuration and requires fresh hashes, SBOM/notices, exact codec and deployment-jurisdiction/patent disposition—not reuse of the F0 realization receipt.

4. Make the scientific stop explicit. The F0 plus BBB court is an E0 subcourt for ingest/time/refusal/replay and boundary measurement/proposals only. It cannot close E0: BBB supplies no paired real recall and is not a dialogue fixture. E0 still needs one separately admitted exact source slice plus real recall, a NarrativeCompilation, and the predeclared question required by the landed plan; no lawful F2 pair is currently admitted. PySceneDetect also needs a complete processed/gap/failure coverage partition: no proposal from an unprocessed extent is not negative boundary evidence.

For F1, B0 may specify the official candidate locator and admission criteria; exact archive/inner-file hashes and excerpt derivation follow only from a separately authorized acquisition. Successful download or decode is not rights evidence.

The later-provider list should be explicitly non-exhaustive. Intentionally deferred independent courts include timed-language/subtitle/OCR/ASR plus MFA, diarization, face/character/active-speaker binding, learned boundaries, object/motion/tracking, visual/audio/joint embeddings, audio events/separation, bounded multimodal proposal/critique, coarse-to-fine scheduling, and FilmFestival/F2 modality-ablation work. None inherits admission or scientific authority from F0/F1.

Disposition: AMEND. With these edges added, the corrected sequence is sufficient and grants no present acquisition, runtime, provider, or narrative authority.
